mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (idempotency_key, request_hash) VALUES (#{key}, #{hash}) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT idempotency_key, request_hash, http_status, CAST(response_json AS text) AS response_json FROM idempotency_keys WHERE idempotency_key = #{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_keys SET http_status = #{status}, response_json = CAST(#{json} AS jsonb) WHERE idempotency_key = #{key}
